description: Start an order with the FickelUSA team for apparel, headwear, or a screen-printed product (artwork review) or for a custom or large order. Requests sent through this tool start at 100 pieces; most items start around 100 pieces. This only creates a pending request for the team to review: no order is confirmed, no payment is taken and nothing ships. Returns a reference number; FickelUSA confirms the details and pricing by email. For most products that are not apparel, headwear, or screen printed, use buy_now instead and have the buyer complete the purchase on the fickelusa.com page.

contact_name.description: Full name of the person starting the order.

email.description: Email address where FickelUSA should send the quote.

imprint_notes.description: Optional logo or imprint notes, e.g. "1-color logo on left chest".

needed_by.description: Optional date the buyer would like the items, YYYY-MM-DD. This is a request only: FickelUSA confirms timing with the quote and does not guarantee dates.

notes.description: Optional notes, e.g. sizes or colors. Links are removed.

quantity.description: Number of pieces (100 or more for requests sent through this tool).

name: request_quote
title: Start an order with FickelUSA
